verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows AnythingLLM connecting to WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Slack, or iMessage. Embedded chat widgets are a website embed, not a messenger surface. API access and custom agent skills are developer building blocks someone could use to build such a bridge, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an everyday user, I can talk to my assistant from the messengers I already use — WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Slack, or iMessage — not just a bespoke web page
